name: Carbon
one_liner: An open-source ERP, MES and QMS that runs a manufacturer's sales, production and quality work in one place.

text.why: Even small manufacturers end up with quotes, orders, work orders and quality records scattered across spreadsheets and separate tools. Carbon is a manufacturing operating system aimed at complex assembly, contract manufacturing, high volume and configure-to-order work, with its full source open.
text.take: Manufacturing ERPs are usually expensive and closed; this one opens its core under the AGPL so you can install it yourself.
build: A web app covering sales (customers, RFQs, quotes, orders, invoices) alongside production (MES) and quality (QMS). Use it as a managed cloud service or self-host it.

who.role: Small and mid-sized manufacturers doing make-to-order, assembly or contract work, and people who run their own internal systems.

start.text: Follow the self-hosting guide at carbon.ms/self-hosted, or start on the managed cloud from carbon.ms.

caveat: The core is AGPL-3.0, but the Enterprise files (packages/ee and any file with .ee. in its name) are under a separate commercial licence, and neither licence covers the Carbon name or logos. The managed cloud is priced per user per month.

license.scope_text: Core AGPL-3.0 · Enterprise files under a commercial licence (github.com/crbnos/carbon)
license.note: Core AGPL-3.0 · Enterprise files under a commercial licence (github.com/crbnos/carbon)
